Name: Mizu's Unicorn and Friends
Author: MizuJakkaru
Description:
[center]﻿﻿[img]https://imgur.com/QO3hCLy.png[/img][/center]
We're awakened from the midsummer night's dream! Do you want more mythical ponies than you can shake a stick at? Good news for you, there's unicorns, pegasus, and qilin, oh my!

[list]
[*]Unicorns, Pegasus, and Qilin all drop [b]Celestial Essence[/b]. This can be used in cooking recipes or potions (optional). [/*]
[*]Unicorns drop [b]Unicorn Horns[/b], Pegasus drop [b]Pegasus Feathers[/b], and Qilin drop [b]Qilin Horns[/b] at high friendship. They're highly cherished items. [/*]
[*]Several cooking recipes to find from the [b]Bookseller[/b] or [b]Krobus [/b]depending on your configuration settings.[/*]
[*][b]Marnie [/b]will add them to her stock after you complete the quest [b]Unlocking Unicorns[/b][b]. [/b]This quest can be started in the [b]Secret Woods[/b] after you have 5 hearts with the [b]Wizard[/b].[/*]
[*](Optional) Unique buff potions using the deluxe produce for each animal. Recipes are available at the [b]Night Market[/b].[/*]
[/list][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22300][b]Special Power Utilities[/b][/url] [b]is required to play this mod. [/b]It allows the recipe book to be dynamic between configuration options.

This mod has optional [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1538]Animal Husbandry[/url] compatibility, with 4 new recipes to find and cook up. These recipes use all vanilla items (+ unicorn, pegasus, or qilin meat) or, if you have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19508]Cornucopia[/url] installed, some of them will change to use those items instead.
[center]
[b][img]https://i.imgur.com/OGZGOGL.png[/img][/b][/center]
By default the Classical Unicorn are enabled and the Medieval Unicorn, Pegasus, and Qilin is disabled. You can toggle on more below.

[b]Enable Medieval Unicorn [/b](false by default): Enables the Medieval Unicorn content. Functions identically to classical unicorns.
[b]Enable Pegasus [/b](false by default): Enables the Pegasus content.
[b]Enable Qilin [/b](false by default): Enables the Qilin content.
[b]Enable Pink Unicorn [/b](false by default): Enables the Pink Unicorn texture and adds it to the possible classical unicorn appearances.
[b]Enable Buff Potions [/b](false by default)[b]:[/b] Enables unique potions using the items from each animal. Recipes can be found at the Night Market.
[center]
[b][img]https://i.imgur.com/KY9I9jB.png[/img][/b][/center]
1. Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]﻿
2. Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿ 
3. Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22300]Special Power Utilities[/url]
4. (Optional) Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1538]Animal Husbandry[/url] for some bonus features
5. Download the main .zip file from this mod and install it the same way you installed the other mods
6. (Optional) Download the Animal Husbandry .zip file from this mod and install it the same way you installed the other mods
7. When starting up the game for the first time, use Generic Mod Config Menu to choose which options you want to turn on or off.
You're ready to play!

To remove this mod, you can just delete it from your mod folder. Any animals and items still left in your save file will [b]safely[/b] be left behind as error items, which can be thrown away or sold by right clicking on animals.

Deleted it by accident? No problem! Just reinstall the mod, and your error items will become normal items again. It's that easy!

[center][img]https://imgur.com/5exTlaQ.png[/img][/center]
